name: text-extractor
description: Extract structured data (names, dates, amounts, emails, URLs, phone numbers) from unstructured text. This skill should be used when pulling contact info from a document, extracting dates and amounts from contracts, or parsing entities from freeform text. Triggers: 'extract names from', 'pull out the dates', 'find all emails in', 'what amounts are mentioned', 'parse this text for entities'.

input.description: Unstructured text to extract data from
